test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate indirect form of the given sentence.**

Anne said, “Next week I have my first skating lesson.”

options.text: Anne said that in the following week she had her first skating lesson.
Anne said that in the next week she has her first skating lesson.
Anne said that the following week I had my first skating lesson.
Anne said that the next week I have my first skating lesson.

solution:
The indirect speech of the given sentence is __'**Anne said that in the following week she had her first skating lesson.'**__
